title: refactor(duration): flatten formatDuration
description: `formatDuration` nested three levels of `if / else`. Early returns and named constants replace them; the output is unchanged, and a test now pins the unit boundaries.
rationale: A behavior-preserving refactor with tests: the same output for every whole, non-negative input. Nothing to block or fix.

extras.note: nit: the test named 'exactly at' asserts the values one second below the switch, and 7199 is no unit switch
the hours branch with zero minutes but leftover seconds (3601 -> '1h') is the one branch condition no test pins
